metrics.profile_summary: Senior marketing leader with 7+ years of experience driving brand growth and e-commerce performance for fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands. Expert in performance marketing, team leadership, and scaling consumer brands across Pakistan and GCC markets.

experience.description: Leads end-to-end marketing strategy, budget management, and team leadership for GCC-based consumer brands across Meta, Google, TikTok, and Snapchat.
Managed marketing strategy and budgets for leading fashion and beauty brands, driving 20% revenue growth through data-driven optimization and team coordination.
Executed integrated marketing campaigns and creative strategies for lifestyle brands, improving engagement by 40% and ROAS by 35%.
Executed performance marketing and brand communication campaigns for fashion and fragrance clients in US and UK markets.

strengths: Deep expertise in consumer brand scaling (Fashion/Beauty)
Proven experience managing both internal teams and external agencies
Full proficiency in GA4 and multi-platform ad reporting
Strong track record of budget ownership and ROI optimization
evaluation.summary: The candidate is an exceptional match, exceeding the requirements for experience and technical skill. He has a proven track record of owning the marketing function end-to-end for consumer brands, including team leadership and budget management.
